description: NaMgF₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent MgF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Mg is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mg-F bond lengths are 1.98 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms.
